name: test_security_headers_baseline

statusDetails.message:
AssertionError: Для ручной проверки не обнаружены защитные HTTP-заголовки: Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Content-Security-Policy (или Report-Only), X-Frame-Options или CSP frame-ancestors
assert not ['Strict-Transport-Security', 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff', 'Referrer-Policy', 'Content-Security-Policy (или Report-Only)', 'X-Frame-Options или CSP frame-ancestors']

description: Missing headers are reported for review; their absence alone does not prove an exploit.
